contracts.commit_point: The ValueError raised inside resolve_sandboxed_path during _resolve_write_path, which must precede the mkdir/os.open/f.write sequence of each tool: write_file (guard at file_write.py line 82 before os.open at 103 and write at 105), overwrite_file (guard at 139 before os.open at 155), edit_file (guard at 190 before the write-back os.open at 234).
contracts.declared_mechanism: FileWriteTools._resolve_write_path routes every write-tool path through resolve_sandboxed_path(root, effective_path, write_mode=True), which raises ValueError for absolute/'..'/~ paths, write-protected targets (subject to the AGENT_WRITABLE_FILES exception), and paths resolving outside the workspace root; each tool catches the ValueError and returns an error message instead of proceeding to open; os.open additionally sets O_NOFOLLOW where available to harden against symlink traversal.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A write-path resolution performed under write_mode that (a) targets any path inside WRITE_PROTECTED_DIRS ('data/', 'config/', 'memory/logs', 'memory/conversations') except the AGENT_WRITABLE_FILES exception ('agent/HEARTBEAT.md'), or (b) is an absolute path, contains a '..' path part, or starts with '~', or (c) resolves to a path outside the workspace root. Any such path reaching os.open/f.write in write_file, overwrite_file, or edit_file is the forbidden end state.

contracts.protected_operation: Agent-invoked workspace file creation, full-content overwrite, and text replacement performed via the write_file, overwrite_file, and edit_file LangChain tools returned by FileWriteTools.get_tools.
contracts.protected_resource: Files under the workspace root, in particular the framework-managed write-protected directories (data/, config/, memory/logs, memory/conversations) and every filesystem location outside the workspace root.
contracts.protection_obligation: Agent workspace write tools (write_file, overwrite_file, edit_file) must refuse to create, overwrite, or modify files at paths inside write-protected directories or outside the workspace sandbox, with the check executed before any file is opened or written. (Merges the duplicate file-write wording of the phase-first and phase-second opinions.)
scope_limits: The obligation covers only the three write tools in FileWriteTools; read-mode resolution (write_mode=False) permits reading any path inside the workspace root, including data/ (sandbox.py lines 51-54).
The ValueError is converted into a returned error string; enforcement is by refusing to open the file, not by raising to the caller.

Write-protected directory names and the agent/HEARTBEAT.md exception are documented in docstrings (sandbox.py lines 8-41, 56-61); the concrete constants in openpaw.core.paths are outside the supplied views.

contracts.commit_point: The raise of ApprovalRequiredError (approval.py lines 108-112) executed in place of handler(request) for unapproved gated tools; handler is reached only when the gate is unconfigured, the tool does not require approval, or the tool was recently approved (approval.py lines 78-79, 84-85, 88-95).
contracts.declared_mechanism: ApprovalToolMiddleware.get_middleware returns a @wrap_tool_call middleware that consults ApprovalGateManager.requires_approval and check_recent_approval, creates a PendingApproval via request_approval, and raises ApprovalRequiredError instead of invoking handler; AgentBuilder passes the middleware list into create_agent, whose comments name 'approval gates' among the wired middleware (builder.py lines 113, 166, 188).
contracts.forbidden_condition: handler(request) executing for a tool_name where requires_approval(tool_name) is True and check_recent_approval is False, unless a PendingApproval has first been created and ApprovalRequiredError raised; more generally, any gated tool effect committing with no approval context configured for the invocation.

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of approval-gated agent tool calls within the agent's tool-call pipeline (the handler invocation wrapped by ApprovalToolMiddleware._check_and_execute).
contracts.protected_resource: The agent's tool execution path — every tool call dispatched through the middleware-wrapped agent produced by AgentBuilder/create_agent.
contracts.protection_obligation: Tool calls that ApprovalGateManager marks as requiring approval must not have their handler execute until a human approval exists (freshly granted or recently granted); execution of a gated tool without approval is forbidden.
scope_limits: If set_context has not configured a manager and session_key, the middleware executes all tool calls normally (approval.py lines 78-79); the gate is inactive without per-invocation configuration.
check_recent_approval permits one post-approval execution without re-prompting and clears after successful execution (approval.py lines 87-95); approved-path execution is by design.

The gate is name-based (requires_approval(tool_name)) and does not inspect tool_args; argument-level policies such as sandbox write protection and the email recipient allowlist are separate mechanisms.

builder.py wires a middleware list into create_agent, but the supplied views do not show the site that instantiates ApprovalToolMiddleware and appends it to that list; the association rests on the builder comments.
